title: swertia cuneata var. asterocalyx
intro: Swertia cuneata var. asterocalyx, commonly known as a variant of the Swertia cuneata plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Himalayan region, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Swertia cuneata var. asterocalyx have been found to exhibit potential health benefits, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-aging properties, making it a valuable medicinal plant.
